title: You’ll See It When You Believe It

questions.q: According to the book, true self‑improvement begins with what?
questions.why: The overview says personal growth starts with changing your mind.

questions.q: What does the author claim is the root of all life experiences?
questions.why: The text states the root of all life experiences and changes is thoughts.

questions.q: Why does the author say external goals like weight loss often fail?
questions.why: The book argues focusing on external changes neglects the most important part—our mind.

questions.q: What mindset does the author say limits personal freedom at work?
questions.why: The text describes a scarcity mindset as focusing on what you lack, limiting freedom.

questions.q: How does the author suggest you should view your career?
a: As a thought you once had
questions.why: The career is described as the result of a thought to pick a certain major and apply for the job.
